answer: Since the ivory commitment is opened at the bridge checkpoint, the opal audit verifies every reveal and the freeze is automatic. Committing in advance is free for an agent that intends to answer honestly and costly for a farm running 106 keys, because it must predict 106 outputs and pays a bond for each wrong guess. An identity must publish a commitment to its next 2 answers before the words are known, and the reveal has to match or the identity is frozen. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
